<title level="1" right="Condition">[Encumbered](/Conditions.aspx?ID=70)</title>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 443

You are carrying more weight than you can manage. While you're encumbered, you're [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) and take a 10-foot penalty to all your Speeds. As with all penalties to your Speed, this can't reduce your Speed below 5 feet.
name: Encumbered
